Messages.Author: Jasper
Messages.Body:
Does Marie Faucigny pay 0 or 1 blood if she equips with an equipment card like "Catacombs". I ask as Catacombs is an equipment card that counts as a location once in play. I'm not sure when it switches from being equipment to a location so I'm not sure if she gets the reduced price or not.

Thanks in advance.

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
Card text is helpful and should be quoted when asking questions to ensure clear and complete answers.

While taking the equip action, equipment that is also a location is only treated as an equipment card until the action is complete. Once in play, after the resolution of the action, the card becomes a location.

Marie's special applies, and she pays 0 blood for the Catacombs.

Catacombs
Equipment
1
This equipment card represents a unique location and does not count as equipment while in play.
When attempting to rescue a vampire from torpor, the vampire with this location gets +1 stealth and burns 1 less blood if successful.

Marie Faucigny
Malkavian antitribu
Capacity: 7
Group: 3
Sabbat Archbishop of Geneva: Once each combat, Marie can burn 1 blood to dodge as a strike. Non-weapon equipment cards cost her 1 less blood or pool to equip.
